names.name: Krispy Kreme Challenge
names.said: Five miles, twelve donuts, one hour. 2,400 calories and 144 grams of fat, and they print the numbers.

text.what: An annual charity run in Raleigh: 2.5 miles to a Krispy Kreme, a dozen donuts, and 2.5 miles back, inside an hour.
text.story: It began in December 2004 with about a dozen friends and is planned and run by Park Scholars at North Carolina State University. Profits go to the North Carolina Children's Hospital; the 2023 race brought total donations past $2.1 million. The event is not affiliated with the Krispy Kreme company.
text.today: The published calorie and fat figures are the only per-dozen nutrition numbers in this directory that a race gave out rather than a label.
